marks.gloss_en: וממאי דרבנן היא? דילמא רבי יהודה היא -- perhaps the baraita is R' Yehuda's, and shows nothing about the Rabbis
since they are not [fruits] made for squeezing, [squeezing is permitted] even ab initio -- on R' Yehuda's view and on the Rabbis' alike
אין, דתנן: R' Eliezer's thorns sanctify a vineyard because in Arabia they keep thorns for camels -- a practice not universal still counts
one who maintains thorns in a vineyard -- R' Eliezer: he has sanctified [the vineyard as kilayim]
מידי איריא? Arabia is a place; here his view is nullified beside all other people
אלא היינו טעמא כדרב חסדא -- beets are not made for squeezing yet their juice, valued, is liquid; so the pomegranates
אלא היינו טעמא כדרב חסדא -- squeezed beets disqualify a mikveh though not made for squeezing, since he valued them; here too, the pomegranates he valued are liquid (= p_hacha_nami_ahshevinhu)
Rav Chisda: beets one squeezed and put into a mikveh disqualify the mikveh by change of colour
דתניא, רבי יעקב אומר: מוחל הרי הוא כמשקה
the mishna there: if wine, vinegar or mochal fell into it and changed its colour -- [the mikveh] is invalid
מדברי רבינו נלמד -- as a cluster may be squeezed into a pot, so a goat may be milked into a pot
אלמא קסבר -- since into a pot is permitted and into a bowl is not, liquid that comes into food is food
a person may squeeze a cluster of grapes into a pot [of food]
מנשיא בן מנחם תנא הוא?! and if the halakha follows the tanna who held like him -- because he held like him, does the halakha follow him? is Menashya ben Menachem the majority of the world?
a zav who milks a goat -- the milk is impure; and if liquid that comes into food is food, with what was it made susceptible?
a zav who milks a goat -- the milk is impure
כדאמר רבי יוחנן: by the drop smeared on the mouth of the teat; here too (= p_ryochanan_tipa)
R' Yochanan: [it is made susceptible] by the drop smeared on the mouth of the teat
one corpse-impure who squeezed olives and grapes: more than an egg-bulk -- impure; and if liquid that comes into food is food, with what was it made susceptible?
one may squeeze plums, quinces and crab apples
Rav Nachman: the halakha follows [the practice of] the house of Menashya bar Menachem [squeezing pomegranates is forbidden]
Rav Pappa: [beets disqualify] because they are a thing from which a mikveh is not made ab initio
R' Shimon: mochal is not like liquid
what is between them? mochal that comes after the heavy pressing
